cases.prompt: We're building a billing assistant. Here are our intents and a month of chat messages — how well do the intents cover what people actually ask, and where should fallback and hand-off go?
expected: Runs scripts/conversation_design.py with the intents and utterances CSVs
Reports coverage, accuracy (if labelled), per-intent precision/recall and confusable pairs with the thresholds stated
Echoes at most 80 characters of any user message; states the router is lexical and sample-based

expected: Coverage 19/24, accuracy 20/23, pay_bill/payment_plan flagged confusable, gate met

checks.check: contains:"Coverage: 19/24 (79.2%) reach an intent at score >= 0.25; 5 go to fallback."
contains:"Accuracy: 20/23 (87.0%) of labelled utterances routed correctly."
contains:"I moved house last week and need to close my account and open a new one at my ne…"

cases.prompt: Design the conversation flow for our billing assistant from these intents.
expected: Asks once for the utterance sample; nothing invented

cases.prompt: We haven't decided the escalation channel or the off-limits topics yet — just pick sensible ones.

checks.check: contains:"Escalation channel: [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Conversation designer]."

cases.prompt: Gate the intent catalog: fail the build if routing accuracy is below 90%.
expected: Accuracy 0.870 is below 0.900; run exits 1 with all outputs written

checks.check: contains:"Gate: FAILED — accuracy 0.870 is below min_accuracy 0.900 (exit 1)."
